Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 by the Insurance Company challenging the Award dated 24.02.2023, passed by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/IVth Additional District Judge, Haridwar in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.31 of 2021, "Smt. Shaista and Others vs. Balbir Singh and Others", by which, learned Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.17,75,632/- (Rupees seventeen lakh seventy five thousand six hundred thirty two) as a compensation along with an interest at the rate of 7% from the date of petition till its actual payment.

sentences.text: Heard Mr. V.K. Kohli, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned counsel for the proposed appellant.

3. Learned Senior Advocate submitted that the offending vehicle, Registration No.UK-08-CA-3683,
was a truck, and, the said truck was never insured with the appellant.
4. Admit.
5.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Learned Senior Advocate requested four weeks' time to deposit 50% amount of the awarded amount.

8. Subject to deposit of Rs.9,00,000/- (Rupees nine lakh) within four weeks from today before the Tribunal concerned, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 24.02.2023 are stayed till further order.
9. Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2023) stands disposed of accordingly.
